stanzas: Cielito lindo, junto a la boca,
No se lo des a nadie,
Cielito lindo, que a mí me toca.
Cielito lindo, a mí me ha herido.
orig.credit: Quirino Mendoza y Cortés (1882), as quoted in Wikipedia's article

stanzas: a pair of dark little eyes,
pretty little heaven, its first nest,
pretty little heaven, has deserved it.
pretty little heaven, beside your mouth,
pretty little heaven, for it belongs to me.
pretty little heaven, Cupid let fly;
if he shot it in play,
pretty little heaven, it has wounded me.

notes: Cielito lindo, "pretty little sky", is a term of endearment for the woman addressed, not a name.

Line 1.1: this edition reads "de la sierra, morena": from the mountains, dark-haired girl. Others print "de la Sierra Morena", the mountain range of southern Spain, which supports the view that the first verse comes from an older Spanish song.
The refrain (stanza 2) is sung after every verse.
